data.label: Instagram vs Website
data.title:
Why Instagram alone is
*hurting your sales*
data.sub: Swipe to see what you're missing →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: You don't *own the platform*
data.body: If Instagram changes its algorithm or suspends your account, your entire business presence disappears instantly. Your website is the only digital space you truly control.
data.fix: Fix: Launch a simple website that you fully own today.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: Customers can't *find you* on Google
data.body: People search for local services on Google, not Instagram. Without a website, you are invisible to thousands of potential customers searching for your exact services.
data.fix: Fix: Build a site optimized for local search terms.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: You have *limited control*
data.body: Instagram forces your content into a specific, rigid template. A website lets you showcase your services exactly how you want to convince new leads.
data.fix: Fix: Create a custom homepage that highlights your services.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: Lack of *professional trust*
data.body: Most customers view a dedicated website as the sign of a legitimate, established business. An Instagram profile alone can look like a hobbyist project.
data.fix: Fix: Add your business address and contact info clearly.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: Harder to *close sales*
data.body: Instagram isn't built for booking jobs or processing payments. A website creates a smooth path for customers to hire you without leaving the page.
data.fix: Fix: Add a 'Get a Quote' button to your site.
